a.xlink:title: OffenseType 1 -- * ChargeOccurrenceA ChargeOccurrence has An OffenseType. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one OffenseType.An OffenseType has some ChargeOccurrences. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a ChargeOccurrence is created, its OffenseType must be assigned. When a ChargeOccurrence is deleted, its OffenseType is not deleted and its list of ChargeOccurrences is decreased. When an OffenseType is deleted, its ChargeOccurrences are not deleted. They are assigned to another OffenseType.
